scope: Root independent dedicated encoded monitor design review
design: One private final Object encodedMonitor; original three stream synchronized blocks change only monitor target.
Existing capture-monitor bookkeeping remains; assertion/closecheck/wipe encoded operations nested capture then encoded only.
Numeric encoded counters get coherent snapshot under encodedMonitor, existing JSON/file IO outside that monitor. No raw history/helper/new framework.
CanaryStream constructor before stream publication unchanged; all matcher methods and fields identical; methods do not callback capture/fileIO/appender/logger.
Appenders/levels/restore outside encodedMonitor; no encoded-to-capture acquisition; stream writer holds only encodedMonitor, preserving serialization and byte order.
Cleanup retains original producer drain and appender stream restoration before assertClosed; wipe only original conditions and successful actual closure; late-write/integrity detection preserved.
tradeoff: Removes source-proven lock coupling with metadata privatefileIO; adds one monitor/access synchronization, no known exclusive cost or performance promise.
